label: Image size
description: Indicates the size of the image (thumbnail, medium, full size).

label: type
description: The subject is an instance of a class.

label: comment
description: A description of the subject resource.

label: domain
description: A domain of the subject property.

label: label
description: A human-readable name for the subject.

label: range
description: A range of the subject property.

label: sub Class Of
description: The subject is a subclass of a class.

label: alternative label
description: The range of skos:altLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.

label: definition
description: A statement or formal explanation of the meaning of a concept.

label: example
description: An example of the use of a concept.

label: hidden label
description: The range of skos:hiddenLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.

label: note
description: A general note, for any purpose.

label: preferred label
description:
A resource has no more than one value of skos:prefLabel per
      language tag, and no more than one value of skos:prefLabel without language tag.

label: documentation files at
description: institution that holds documentation files about the subject

label: place of disappearance
description: place where people or things have disappeared; link with P746 (date of disappearance)

label: recorded participant
description: agent taking an active role as a participant in a nonfiction moving image or other recorded work

label: topic's main Wikimedia portal
description: Wikimedia portal associated with this topic

label: source of transfer
description: entity that a transferred item is initially associated with, before this process associates it with another entity

label: described by source
description: work where this item is described, in statistical contexts, a methodological note describing the data

label: executive producer
description: executive producer of a movie, TV show, or other piece of media or entertainment

label: published in
description: larger work that a given work was published in, like a journal, a website, a collection, a book or a music album

label: end cause
description: qualifier used together with the end date qualifier (P582) to specify the reason for the end

label: NATO code for grade
description: NATO Code for Grades of Military Personnel

label: category related to list
description: Wikimedia category that matches the Wikimedia list

label: category for people buried here
description: Wikimedia category for people with a burial site within this area

label: category of associated people
description: Wikimedia category for people associated with this place or organization

label: depicts
description: entity visually depicted in an image, literarily described in a work, or otherwise incorporated into an audiovisual or other medium; see also P921, 'main subject'

label: list of characters
description: Wikimedia page with the list of characters for this work

label: different from
description: item that is different from another item, with which it may be confused

label: aspect ratio (W:H)
description: image width to height ratio of flags, films, photographs, and other images

label: sex or gender
description: sex or gender identity of human or animal. For human: male, female, non-binary, intersex, transgender female, transgender male, agender, etc. For animal: male organism, female organism. Groups of same gender use subclass of (P279)

label: statistical unit of the dataset
description: base item of this database or statistical set

label: has list
description: Wikimedia list related to this subject

label: issued by
description: organisation or other agent that issues or allocates an identifier, code, classification number, etc.

label: stated in
description: to be used in the references field to refer to the information document or database in which a claim is made; for qualifiers use P805; for the type of document in which a claim is made use P3865

label: category for recipients of this award
description: link to Wikimedia category for recipients of this award

label: BBFC rating
description: British media content rating (add BBFC reference with qualifier "P2676")

label: RARS rating
description: rating in the Russian media content rating system

label: Kijkwijzer rating
description: Dutch media content rating system

label: copyright license
description: license under which this copyrighted work is released

label: subclass of
description: this item is a subclass (subset) of that item; ALL instances of this item are instances of that item; different from P31 (instance of), e.g.: volcano is a subclass of mountain; Everest is an instance of mountain

label: house publication
description: media that speaks for an organization or a movement, and that is usually edited by its members

label: permanent duplicated item
description: this item duplicates another item and they can't be merged, as one Wikimedia project includes two pages, e.g. in different scripts or languages (examples: cdowiki, gomwiki, nanwiki). Use P31=Q17362920 when the Wikimedia project could merge the pages.

label: KML file
description: item with sitelinks to Wikimedia page containing text of a relevant KML file

label: instance of
description: type to which this subject corresponds/belongs. Different from P279 (subclass of); for example: K2 is an instance of mountain; volcano is a subclass of mountain

label: birthday
description: item for day and month on which the subject was born. Used when full "date of birth" (P569) isn't known.

label: broadcast by
description: channel, network, website or service that broadcast this item over radio, television or the Internet

label: next lower rank
description: lower rank or level in a ranked hierarchy like sport league, military ranks. If there are several possible, list each one and qualify with "criterion used" (P1013), avoid using ranks and date qualifiers. For sports leagues/taxa, use specific properties instead.

label: next higher rank
description: higher rank or level in a ranked hierarchy like sport league, military ranks. If there are several possible, list each one and qualify with "criterion used" (P1013), avoid using ranks and date qualifiers. For sports leagues/taxa, use specific properties instead.

label: route diagram template
description: Wikimedia template with route diagram

label: newspaper format
description: physical size of a newspaper (berliner, broadsheet, tabloid, etc.)

label: captured with
description: equipment (e.g. model of camera, lens, microphone), used to capture this image, video, audio, or data

label: category for employees of the organization
description: Wikimedia category for people who work or worked at this organization

label: distribution format
description: method (or type) of distribution for the subject

label: FPB rating
description: rating of a film or video game in the South African media content rating system

label: said to be the same as
description: this item is said to be the same as that item, though this may be uncertain or disputed

label: on focus list of Wikimedia project
description: property to indicate that an item is of particular interest for a Wikimedia project. This property does not add notability. Items should not be created with this property if they are not notable for Wikidata. See also P6104, P972, P2354

label: Wikimedia outline
description: item about an outline of the topic at Wikimedia sites

label: powered by
description: equipment used by the subject to convert a source into mechanical or electrical energy

label: surname for other gender
description: gender inflection of surname, patronymic or matronymic

label: website account on
description: website that the person or organization has an account on (use with P554) Note: only used with reliable source or if the person or organization disclosed it.

label: model item
description: defines which item is a best practice example of modelling a subject, which is described by the value of this property, usage instructions at Wikidata:Model items

label: depicted part
description: use as qualifier for "depicts" (P180) or image (P18)

label: source of energy
description: describes the source of energy an animated object (machine or animal) uses

label: category for eponymous categories
description: Wikimedia category that contains subcategories dedicated to specific instances of the said item

label: taxon found at location
description: plant or animals taxon described as present in location, not countries or first-level subnational entities. Requires reference. Ref should cover a limited number of taxa for specific location.

label: related category
description: Wikimedia category is related to this item

label: OFLC classification
description: rating in the media content rating system of New Zealand

label: category for the interior of the item
description: Commons category for media files depicting interior views of this item (object, place)

label: top-level Internet domain
description: Internet domain name system top-level code

label: category for maps or plans
description: name of the Wikimedia category specifically for maps or plans of this item

label: military size designation
description: organizational size classification or designation used to indicate relative size of an entity within an organization (property under development)

label: symbol of
description: item of which the image is a symbol

label: content partnership category
description: Wikimedia Commons category for media files contributed by this institution

label: bibliography
description: Wikimedia page that gives a selection of relevant texts on the given topic

label: origin of the watercourse
description: main source of a river, stream or lake

label: indexed in bibliographic review
description: bibliographic review(s) and/or database(s) which index this academic journal

label: sexual orientation
description: the sexual orientation of the person relative to their declared gender — use ONLY IF they have stated it themselves, unambiguously, or it has been widely agreed upon by historians after their death

label: topic's main category
description: main Wikimedia category

label: not found in
description: publication or database relevant to the topic that would generally include similar subjects, but in which the subject isn't described or attested. Use if there is no external-id property for the work.

label: catalog
description: catalog for the item, or, as a qualifier of P528 – catalog for which the 'catalog code' is valid

label: catalogue raisonné
description: comprehensive, annotated listing of all the known artworks by an artist either in a particular medium or all media.
